    Definitions
    釋義



    “Target Medical”                               Beijing Target Medical Technologies Co., Ltd. # (北京天地和協科
                                                   技有限公司), a limited liability company established in the PRC on
                                                   November 18, 1999 and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lepu Medical,
                                                   one of the controlling shareholders of the Company
    「天地和協」                                 指       北京天地和協科技有限公司，一家於1999 年11 月18 日在中國成立的
                                                   有限公司，為本公司控股股東之一樂普醫療的全資附屬公司

    "TAVR"                                         transcatheter aortic valve replacement, a catheter-based technique
                                                   to implant a new aortic valve in a minimally invasive procedure
                                                   that does not involve open-chest surgery to correct severe aortic
                                                   stenosis
    「經導管主動脈瓣置換術」                           指       經導管主動脈瓣置換術，一種基於導管的技術，通過不涉及開胸手術
                                                   的微創手術植入新的主動脈瓣，以矯正嚴重的主動脈瓣狹窄

    “TMVR”                                         transcatheter mitral valve repair, which provides a newer, minimally
                                                   invasive option for treating the most common form of mitral valve
                                                   leakage for people who cannot undergo open-heart surgery. It
                                                   is implanted via a tri-axial transcatheter technique and involves
                                                   suturing together the anterior and posterior mitral valve leaflets
    「TMVR」                                 指       經導管二尖瓣修復術，為無法接受心臟直視手術的人治療最常見的二
                                                   尖瓣滲漏提供了一種更新、微創選擇。通過三軸經導管技術進行植
                                                   入，包括縫合二尖瓣前後瓣葉

    “TMVr-F”                                       transfemoral mitral valve clip repair, a catheter-based technique
                                                   to repair the mitral valve in an interventional therapy that does not
                                                   involve open-chest surgery
    「TMVr-F」                               指       經股二尖瓣夾修復術，一種基於導管的技術，以在介入治療中修復二
                                                   尖瓣而無需開胸

    “TMVCRS”                                       transapical mitral valve repair system (chordal), a catheter-based
                                                   system with two configurations, one enabling artificial mitral chordae
                                                   implantation and the other enabling edge-to-edge chordae repair
    「TMVCRS」                               指       經心尖二尖瓣修復系統（腱索），一種基於導管且具備兩種裝置的系
                                                   統，一種實現人工二尖瓣腱索植入，另一種實現緣對緣腱索修復

     Non-IFRS Measure – Adjusted net profit                               非國際財務報告準則計量 － 經調整純利

     To supplement our consolidated financial information which           為補充我們根據《國際財務報告準則》呈
     is presented in accordance with IFRS, we set forth below our         列的綜合財務資料，我們於下文載列我們
     adjusted net profit as an additional financial measure which         的經調整純利作為並非根據《國際財務報
     is not presented in accordance with IFRS. We believe this is         告準則》計量的額外財務計量。我們認為
     meaningful because potential impacts of certain items which our      此屬有意義之舉，原因為管理層認為與我
     management do not consider closely relevant to our operating         們的經營表現並非密切相關的若干項目的
     performance have been excluded, and this would be useful for         潛在影響已獲剔除，且有利於我們的投資
     our investors to compare our financial results directly with those   者將我們的財務業績直接與我們同業公司
     of our peer companies.                                               的財務業績進行比較。

     Adjusted net profit eliminates the effect of certain non-cash or     經調整純利撇除若干非現金或非經常性項
     non-recurring items, namely (i) listing expenses, net of tax; (ii)   目的影響，即(i)上市開支（稅後）；(ii)重新
     net foreign exchange losses from the retranslation of the USD-       換算以美元計值的贖回負債所得外匯虧損
     denominated redemption liabilities; (iii) interest expense on        淨額；(iii)贖回負債利息開支；及(iv)以股
     redemption liabilities; and (iv) share-based payment expenses.       份為基礎的付款開支。《國際財務報告準
     The term “adjusted net profit” is not defined under IFRS.            則》並無對「經調整純利」一詞作出界定。
     The use of adjusted net profit has material limitations as an        使用經調整純利作為分析工具具有重大局

      Case: Biodegradable MemoSorb® PFO Occluder approved by the NMPA
           案例：MemoSorb®生物可降解卵圓孔未閉封堵器獲國家藥監局批准

  On September 11, 2023, the Biodegradable MemoSorb® PFO Occluder independently
  developed by LEPU ScienTech was approved by the National Medical Products
  Administration (NMPA), making it the world’s first approved biodegradable PFO
  occluder. Unlike the traditional metal occluders, biodegradable occluders can be
  degraded over time into carbon dioxide and water upon the completion of endothelial
  repair, they would not be permanent implants in the human body, and this will
  lead to more optimal surgical treatment options for patients. The NMPA approval
  of our MemoSorb ® PFO Occluder marks the entry into the biodegradable era for
  the prevention and treatment of cardioembolic stroke. In the same month, the
  Biodegradable MemoSorb® PFO Occluder was used for the purpose of compassionate
  use for the first time in the world after its commercialization.
  2023年9月11日，心泰醫療自主研發的MemoSorb ® 生物可降解卵圓孔未閉封堵器獲國家
  藥監局(NMPA)批准，成為全球首個獲批的可降解的卵圓孔未閉封堵器。與傳統金屬封堵
  器不同，生物可降解封堵器在內皮修復完成後可隨時間降解為二氧化碳和水，不會在人體
  中長久殘留，這將為患者帶來更多更優化的手術治療方案，也標誌着心源性卒中防治器械
  進入可降解時代。同月，MemoSorb ® 生物可降解卵圓孔未閉封堵器完成上市後全球首例
  國際同情使用。

                       Report:
                       描述或解釋在編備環境、社會及管治報告時如何應用下列匯報原

                       Materiality: The ESG report should disclose: (i) the process to

RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL                                風險管理及內部監控

The Board is responsible for maintaining solid and effective        董事會負責維持穩健妥善且有效的風險管
risk management and internal control systems to safeguard           理及內部監控系統，以保障股東的投資及
investments of Shareholders and the Company’s assets. The           本公司的資產。風險管理及內部監控系統
risk management and internal control systems are designed           乃為識別、評估及報告潛在風險以及實施
to identify, assess and report on potential risks and implement     控制措施而設計，以減緩而非完全消除與
control measures, to mitigate rather than to completely eliminate   實現業務目標有關的風險。此等系統針對
the risks associated with achieving our business objectives.        重大錯誤陳述或損失提供合理但非絕對的
These systems provide a reasonable but not absolute assurance       保證。
against material misstatement or loss.

The key features of the Group’s risk management and internal        本集團風險管理及內部監控系統的主要特
control systems include the following:                              徵包括以下各項：

•    An organized structure with clearly defined and distinct       •   具有明確界定及明顯的權限及責任
     scope of authority and responsibilities;                           範圍的組織架構；

•    A comprehensive financial accounting system to provide         •   全面財務會計系統，以提供各種績
     for various performance measurement indicators and to              效計量指標並確保有關規則得以遵
     ensure compliance with relevant rules;                             守；

•    Annual plans prepared by senior management of the              •   本公司高級管理層經參考重大潛在
     Company on ESG, financial reporting, operations and                風險後就 ESG、財務申報、營運及
     compliance with reference to significant potential risks;          合規編製的年度計劃；

•    Strict prohibition of unauthorised expenditures;               •   嚴禁未經授權的開支；

•    Guidelines on the dissemination of confidential and            •   有關發佈機密及敏感資料的指引；
     sensitive information;

•    Specific approval from executive Director/responsible          •   於就所有重大事項作出承諾前須獲
     senior executive of the Company prior to commitment in             得執行董事 ╱ 本公司負責的資深行
     all material matters;                                              政人員的特定批准；

     the qualifications and experiences possessed by our staff          本集團會計及財務申報職能的員工

      The main procedures used to identify, evaluate and manage              用於識別、評估及管理重大潛在風險的主
      significant potential risks are as follows:                            要程序如下：

      •     Identify – We identify current and emerging risks in our         •   識別 － 我們識別業務營運中的現
            business operations and categorize those risks into a                時及新興風險，並根據時間範圍、
            reasonable profile based on timeframe, likelihood, intensity         可能性、程度及影響嚴重性將該風
            and impact severity. We establish four risk categories,              險分類為合理概況。我們建立四個
            including strategic risks, financial risks, operating risks          風險類別，包括戰略風險、財務風
            and legal risks. The Audit Committee has established                 險、經營風險及法律風險。審計委
            and oversaw the whistleblowing policy. In line with that             員會已建立並監督舉報政策。為配
            commitment, the Company expects and encourages the                   合該承諾本公司預期並鼓勵本公司
            employees, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders               內任何對失當行為或舞行為提出質
            who have concerns about any suspected misconduct or                  疑的僱員、客戶、供應商及其他利
            malpractice within the Company to voice their concerns.              益相關者表達其關注事項。所有舉
            All whistleblowing reports are investigated to the fullest           報報告均將盡可能進行詳盡調查，
            extent possible and reported to the Audit Committee.                 並向審計委員會報告。

      •     Assess – We assess and prioritize risks so that the most         •   評估 － 我們評估風險並考慮優先
            important risks can be identified and dealt with. Based              次序，以便識別並處理最重要的風
            on both qualitative and quantitative analyses, we prioritize         險。基於定性及定量分析，我們就
            risks in terms of likelihood and impact severity.                    可能性及影響嚴重性方面優先考慮
                                                                                 風險。

      •     Mitigate – Based on our assessment of (i) the probability        •   減緩 － 根據我們就 (i) 風險的可能性
            and impact severity of the risks; (ii) cost and benefit of the       及影響嚴重性；(ii) 減緩計劃的成本
            mitigation plans, we choose the appropriate option for               及利益進行的評估，我們就應風險
            dealing with risks, including risk elimination by suspending         選擇適當方案，包括透過暫停相關
            the associated business activities, risk reduction by                業務活動除風險、透過採取適當的
            adopting appropriate control measures, risk transfer by              控制措施降低風險、透過外判或投
            outsourcing or purchasing insurance policies, and risk               購保單轉移風險及透過選擇接受重
            acceptance by choosing to accept risks of low priority.              要性較低的風險等方式接納風險。

      •     Measure – We measure our risk management system                  •   計量 － 我們透過釐定變動是否已實
            by determining if changes have been implemented and                  施以及變動是否有效的方式來計量
            if changes are effective. In the event of any weakness in            風險管理系統。於控制不力的情況

                  represent actual and regularly occurring market                   在公平交易中實際定期發生的

                  counter derivatives) is determined using valuation                價值乃使用估值技術釐定，該

                                                                          理

         The fair value of awarded shares granted to                      根據僱員持股計劃授予僱員的
         employees under the ESOP less amount paid by                     獎勵股份之公允價值減去僱員
         employees is recognised as an employee benefits                  所支付的金額乃確認為相關服
         expense over the relevant service period, being                  務期間（即股份歸屬期）的僱員
         the vesting period of the shares, and the credit is              福利開支，於以股份為基礎的
         recognised in equity in the share-based payment                  薪酬儲備中確認為權益貸項。
         reserves. The fair value of the shares is measured               該等股份的公允價值於授出日
         at the grant date. The number of shares expected                 期計量。預期歸屬的股份數目
         to vest is estimated based on the non-market                     乃基於非市場歸屬條件估計。
         vesting conditions. The estimates are revised at the             該等估計乃於各報告期末進行
         end of each reporting period and adjustments are                 修改，相關調整於損益及以股
         recognised in profit or loss and the share-based                 份為基礎的薪酬儲備中確認。
         payment reserves. Where shares are forfeited due                 倘股份因僱員無法滿足服務條
         to a failure by the employee to satisfy the service              件而被沒收，則先前就該等股
         conditions, any expenses previously recognised in                份確認的任何費用自沒收之日
         relation to such shares are reversed in profit or loss           起轉回損益。
         at the date of the forfeiture.
